## Life Tip of the Week

### Register to Vote

If you want to vote in the upcoming election, it's
time to register to vote:

> [https://www.vote.nyc/page/register-vote](https://www.vote.nyc/page/register-vote)

Early voting begins at the end of October: need to be registered by then

- Forms must be _received_ not just mailed

### On the Ballot

- Governor / Lt. Governor
- Comptroller, Attorney General
- Federal & State Representatives
- Various Judge

for more see <https://findmypollsite.vote.nyc/>.
